scope: One bounded complete navigation-method attempt, not another latent-state audit or KDA gate version. Temporal information reaches the scalar value only through explicit short motion forecasts and candidate-conditioned relative geometry. This common interface is not claimed novel by itself.
sensor: 360-degree centre-ray human-body occlusion; no range cutoff or random dropout
association: Ideal association of previously visible actors; identity is not a numeric model input
primary: 10/20-person SR equally weighted across native circle and square; 5-person and per-geometry outcomes separately reported
checkpoint_selection: Final fixed-budget checkpoint, explicitly reloaded for every closed-loop evaluation. No test-based early stopping or checkpoint selection.
prediction_loss: Mean squared velocity-normalized displacement error at later legal visible measurements only, weight 0.1; original scalar MC-return MSE remains weight 1. CV has no learned predictor or prediction loss.
predictor_current_contract: Every learned predictor receives the same legal current actor position and pooled relative position/velocity/radius of every currently retained neighbour. History encoding additionally uses translation-relative actor motion. Current is not weakened by withholding available current crowd geometry. The initial incomplete-neighbour preflight was interrupted and archived before final results; all formal arms restart from initialization.
common_consumer: At observed value queries use forecasts at 0/.25/.5/1/2s. At native successor queries shift those points by .25s. Candidate robot velocity extrapolation provides geometric features, not a forced multi-second execution or an oracle Q. Native one-step reward, CV risk/safety filtering and smoothing are unchanged. No memory hidden state bypasses the predicted positions into the value head.
parent_reference: Reload the completed V8 gru_context weights for each paired seed, verify original IL/RL budgets and shared demonstration content, and evaluate on these new cases. Do not compare old-case SR to new-case SR.
allowed_rescue: At most one diagnosed mechanism revision after all A arms finish. If motion estimates are poor, inspect supervised loss/causal input availability. If forecasts improve but action quality does not, inspect whether the consumer uses future geometry. Any revised consumer is applied and retrained across all common-interface arms with a new frozen protocol; no KDA-only tuning, no hidden goals, no scene/reward/action changes. No automatic additional architecture versions.
stopping: Finish all four paired arms even if an early result is positive or negative. A simple-equivalent result stops this mechanism version. A KDA-specific contribution requires improvement against same-interface GRU, learned-current, CV and the frozen strong parent, then fresh confirmation; a prediction-only improvement is not success.
